name: Injoku Studio Take 2 ~Kangoku Kichiku Showtime~
original_name: 淫辱スタジオ TAKE2～姦獄鬼畜ショータイム
source:
At a recording studio for an adult game, Shinobu, a young voice actress, infuriates Saori, an experienced voice actress for adult games. "I don't wanna be an voice actress for adult games anymore!" Saori gets mad and asks Kenichi, a scenario writer for adult games, to rape Shinobu. He accepts her offer for his next game scenario....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090107031936/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1009022]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
在一間成人遊戲錄音室裡，年輕配音員忍激怒了經驗豐富的成人遊戲配音員沙織。「我再也不想當成人遊戲配音員了！」沙織勃然大怒，請求成人遊戲編劇健一強暴忍。為了下一部遊戲的劇本，他接受了這個提議……

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090107031936/http://www.erogeshop.com/product_info.php/products_id/1009022]ErogeShop[/url]]
